d:
Jammu-kashmir ke kulgam zile men 11 navanbar ko CRPF ki petroling parti par hamle ke bad suraksha balon ka sarch opreshan dusre din bhi jari hai.
Vahin, is bich kishtavar zile men do pulis valon ke shav baramad hue hain, jo jammu-kashmir pulis ki speshal opreshans grup men tainat the.
Riport: jahangir ali
Aavaz: mukund jha
Editing: altaf
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
